title: 'One Nation, One Time': Why Isro is sending atomic clocks into space
content: India's ISRO is on the verge of launching the NVS-03 satellite, significantly boosting the nation's navigation strengths. Equipped with an indigenous atomic clock, this satellite will improve time sovereignty and support the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System, allowing services to reach beyond India's borders. The launch symbolizes India's resolve to establish independent navigation systems and accurate time synchronization, echoing the government's dream of a standardized time framework across the country.

title: Google sees its worst day in 20 years, but why it may not be alone
content: Alphabet's report on October 29 revealed its slowest growth, causing its stock to plunge by 12.6%. Investor worries about the company's hefty AI infrastructure investments impacting cash flows surfaced immediately. Other tech behemoths like Microsoft and Amazon are equally grappling with the financial burden of escalating AI costs. Additionally, Meta's capital expenditure projections suggest ongoing struggles with investment commitments despite higher revenues.

title: Nagaland United to become first club from state on national stage with IFL debut

title: Arkansas couple pays $8,000 to access land by road; court backs boundary route
content: An Arkansas couple who paid their neighbours $8,000 for an 18-foot-wide road to access their land near Beaver Lake have lost a dispute over its location. The Arkansas Court of Appeals upheld a route along the neighbours' property boundary, despite concerns about construction costs and difficult terrain. One judge disagreed, warning that the approved route could be unusable without expensive work.

title: Father, son fall to death from 23rd floor while plucking flowers in Greater Noida
content: In a heartbreaking incident on Friday, a father and his young son tragically fell from their apartment balcony while trying to gather flowers for a religious occasion. Randeep Patra, aged 40, and his 11-year-old son, Aarav, suffered critical injuries from the fall and sadly passed away in the hospital. Authorities are now investigating the tragic circumstances of their deaths, with their bodies sent for postmortem following legal procedures.

title: 2 videos, 3 killings, 1 state-level shooter: How parking row turned deadly in Lucknow
content: On October 24, three men from a family were killed in Saadatganj, Lucknow, following a parking dispute. The accused, Rishabh Shukla, claimed self-defense as he shot the victims during the confrontation. Videos surfaced online showing the attack and identifying victims, leading to public outrage. Authorities removed encroachments linked to the accused's property and took action against related illegal constructions.

title: From Catholic to Muslim, women across faiths celebrated Karwa Chauth in Lucknow
content: Karwa Chauth is being celebrated by women from different faiths in Lucknow. These celebrations involve prayers for the health and happiness of their husbands. Participants express their commitment to marriage through rituals, such as fasting throughout the day. Couples join in the festivities, often exchanging meaningful gestures that represent their love. This practice illustrates how cultural traditions are embraced across various communities, transcending religious divides.

title: Silk traces found on 101 ancient Chinese ritual objects dating back 3,000 years
content: Scientists studying 3,000-year-old objects from China's Sanxingdui archaeological site have found silk traces on 101 artefacts, including bronze masks, gold, jade and ivory objects. Published in the journal Antiquity, the study suggests that ancient Shu people used silk to wrap or cover objects during rituals. Researchers also identified red pigments and different weaving patterns, offering clues about ancient textile practices.

title: Meet Mahi Malhani, 17: Delhi student's waste-sorting robot hits 90% success
content: Seventeen-year-old Mahi Malhani developed TRASHbot to improve waste disposal using artificial intelligence technology. The robot detects, collects, and sorts waste with impressive accuracy and efficiency. Initial trials were successful in various locations, including her home and schools. Mahi has received recognition in innovation competitions for her project and aims to expand its capabilities. Future versions of TRASHbot may assist in rural areas with unique challenges.

title: Oracle says it isn’t worried about $165 billion Project Jupiter, but investors are
content: Oracle says it is not too worried about Project Jupiter, its $165 billion AI data centre in New Mexico, even as investors and lenders grow anxious. Oracle cloud chief Mahesh Thiagarajan called it one of 30 to 40 projects in development each quarter. The Stargate site for OpenAI faces pending power approvals, a force majeure notice to Blue Owl and a stressed $18 billion loan.

title: Australian stingless bee honey blocks every bacterium tested in lab study
content: Researchers at the University of Sydney are investigating the medicinal properties of honey from stingless bees. The honey has shown effectiveness against various bacterial and fungal pathogens, including difficult-to-treat strains. Findings suggest that sugarbag honey is comparable in strength to well-known medical-grade honeys. While propolis displayed selective antimicrobial activity, the reason for honey's potency remains unclear. Further research is needed to identify the beneficial compounds within the honey.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ KC Current opens free soccer league for 120 children
content: The Kansas City Current launched a free youth soccer league in July to help children overcome financial barriers to sports. The program provides 120 players aged 8 to 10 with uniforms, Nike cleats and equipment at no cost. Supported by community partners, the initiative also offers coach stipends and referee training for teenagers. The league aims to expand access, support local families and encourage greater participation, particularly among girls.

title: Andre Agassi’s $6.5M Las Vegas land sells for $18.15M in 2026
content: Andre Agassi sold his 1.8-acre homesite in Las Vegas’ exclusive Summit Club for $18.15 million, nearly tripling the $6.5 million he paid in 2018. The sale generated an $11.65 million gain before expenses. His brother, Phillip Agassi, said the tennis legend reconsidered building a large mansion as his children grow older. The buyer’s identity remains unknown, while the property’s location and luxury surroundings add to its appeal.

title: 40 villas in 2.5 years? Why Rajasthan IAS officer Shikhar Agrawal was put on APO
content: In a significant development, the Rajasthan government has placed senior IAS officer Shikhar Agrawal under an awaiting posting order amidst serious allegations. These claims suggest that Agrawal and his family acquired multiple properties from the same firm within a two-and-a-half-year span. Previously, he held vital roles, including additional chief secretary of industries.

title: German teacher on paid sick leave for 16 years faces €248k fraud charges
content: A 62-year-old German educator faces fraud charges after reportedly taking a 16-year sick leave, during which she allegedly collected over €248,000 in salary. Investigators believe she fabricated medical documentation to support her prolonged absence from the classroom. Although she engaged in scuba diving, there’s no evidence of her undertaking any other professional work. The court is currently reviewing the case to determine if a full trial is warranted.

title: Delhi-Varanasi Vande Bharat sleeper's First AC has switchable privacy glass
content: The Vande Bharat Sleeper Express is revolutionizing luxury travel with its First AC compartment, offering unparalleled comfort for overnight trips between New Delhi and Varanasi. Passengers can expect a host of amenities, including privacy glass, individual reading lights, and enhanced cushioning for a restful journey. Commencing operations on October 31, this train will operate six days a week and provides three accommodation classes to cater to varying preferences.

title: Van Gogh self-portrait found hidden behind painting in 2022 X-ray scan
content: A self-portrait of Vincent van Gogh was discovered concealed behind another painting after many years. The hidden portrait was found during routine examinations ahead of an exhibition. This discovery highlights Van Gogh's habit of reusing canvases due to financial difficulties throughout his life. Conservators are now working to reveal the portrait without damaging the original painting. Visitors to the exhibition were able to view the hidden portrait's X-ray image.

title: No eyewitness to wife's murder: How HC found husband guilty on circumstantial evidence
content: The Tripura High Court has confirmed a life sentence for a man convicted of murdering his wife, relying on compelling evidence. This included medical reports and witness accounts showcasing a history of abuse and financial demands. Circumstantial evidence surrounding the tragic incident, along with corroboration from a neighbor, reinforced the court's determination that the evidence conclusively established his guilt beyond reasonable doubt.

Despite submitting required documents, the insurer initially refused the claim, leading to the consumer's appeal. The commission found the insurer liable for not settling the claim and ordered compensation.

title: MLC polls: Gadkari confidant's revolt may have hurt BJP in RSS bastion Nagpur

The election resulted in over 15,000 invalid votes in Nagpur, indicating voter discontent and potential errors. BJP leader Chandrashekhar Bawankule acknowledged the defeat and pledged to improve strategies for future elections. Shiv Sena's involvement also contributed to disputes within the ruling coalition regarding support for various candidates.

title: 'Two of the greatest in history': Hesson backs struggling Babar Azam, Fakhar Zaman

Despite facing recent challenges, the team has displayed resilience, clinching three successive victories. Hesson praises the squad's evolution and is eager to witness their peak performance in the championship match, even in the absence of notable input from key players.

title: Mahatma Gandhi's grandson reclaims 30-acre land in US after 20-month legal battle

Gregory Black claimed ownership of the land under the adverse possession rule after 15 years. Following a legal battle, the court found that Black could not prove his exclusive possession. The court directed Black to remove his belongings and surrender possession of the land.

title: Amidst winds of change, Rohit Sharma is the glue Mumbai Indians need right now
content: Mumbai Indians are undergoing a major overhaul, with Kieron Pollard taking charge as head coach and several key members exiting the support staff. Amid the uncertainty, bringing Rohit Sharma back as captain could offer stability, continuity and breathing space for the new coaching setup. With Tilak Varma viewed as a future leader, IPL 2027 could be about managing transition rather than chasing immediate glory.

title: Diljit Dosanjh concert: Delhi Metro services extended, traffic curbs around JLN Stadium

title: 10 overground workers arrested in terror financing case in J&K's Shopian
content:
Representative image

NEW DELHI: Jammu and Kashmir Police arrested 10 overground workers (OGWs) in connection with a terror financing module in Shopian district, officials told PTI on Friday. The arrests were made during an investigation into suspected terror financing activities in the south Kashmir district. Police said the accused were allegedly involved in supporting terrorist networks through financial and logistical assistance. More details awaited.

title: Poverty plunges in India, but top 10% earn 13 times more than bottom 10%: World Bank
content: 496 million people have been lifted out of poverty between 2011 and 2023 . workers in the top 10% earn a median income nearly 13 times higher than those in the bottom 10%, according to the world bank's October 2026 India Poverty and Equity Brief .

title: 'Rs 12,000cr trade at stake': Traders now write to Sonia to defer Rahul's Nov 1 rally
content: the rally is expected to draw around 10 lakh people and 15,000 to 20,000 vehicles to central Delhi . the trade body warned of severe economic losses during the peak festive shopping season . it warned that the large gathering could affect the movement of goods and shoppers across the markets .

title: ‘Swimming competition in Yamuna?’ Rijiju challenges Manoj Tiwari after his dip
content: BJP MP Manoj Tiwari took a dip in the Yamuna at Sonia Vihar in Delhi . he praised the efforts to clean the river under the leadership of chief minister Rekha Gupta . his party colleague and union minister Kiren Rijiju proposed a swimming competition .

title: Ukraine puts Russian refinery strikes 'on pause' amid Trump pressure
content: the unofficial pause is expected to remain in place until after the US midterm elections . the reported suspension comes amid renewed efforts to revive US-backed negotiations aimed at ending Europe's deadliest conflict since world war II .

title: Israel polls: Arab parties may hold key to govt formation as Netanyahu falls short
content: arab parties emerge as kingmakers in the next government . a combined 19 seats could offer the opposition a path to power . but disagreements within the opposition and uncertainty over cooperation with arab factions could complicate efforts .

title: Bhutan glacial lake outburst: Flash flood alert in Bengal, Assam; several evacuated
content: more than 10,000 people have been moved to relief shelters and safer locations in west Bengal . authorities in assam's Dhubri district have stepped up preparedness to deal with possible downstream effects . the outburst sent large volumes of water downstream through the Mo Chhu river towards the Sankosh river system .

title: Surrender before Dec 1: SC cancels bail of Anant Singh in murder case
content: a bench of justices MM Sundresh and PV Varale observed that the high court had erred in granting Singh bail without adequately considering the nature of the offence and his criminal antecedents . the verdict comes days after the ruling Janata Dal expelled Singh and his wife, former MLA Neelam Devi, from the party for six years over alleged anti-party activities .

title: INDIA bloc postpones 'public impeachment' of CEC Gyanesh Kumar due to rains
content: the proceedings are part of the inDIA bloc’s campaign against alleged ‘vote chori’ . the programme was scheduled to take place at 10, Rajaji Marg, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s residence in new Delhi . it was planned as a public expression of its demand for Kumar’s removal .

title: 3 killed as two helicopters collide mid-air near Oregon airport in US
content: two helicopters collided mid-air near an airport in northwest Oregon . the collision occurred around 2:15 pm local time . one of the helicopters was carrying two people, a flight instructor from Texas and a student pilot from the united kingdom .
